newsitem.title: PERU: Telefonica to issue new debt.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica to issue new debt.

text.p: Spanish-owned Telefonica del Peru said Monday it received permission from Peru's stocks and securitites board to issue up to 80 million soles in short-term commercial debt paper.
A Telefonica official confirmed this would be the third in a global program of issues for a total of up to $180 million.
"The date of the auction of this third issue will be defined by the vice-presidency," the official said, adding that the money raised would be used for expansion and renovation work.
Telefonica del Peru is controlled by Telefonica de Espana.
